#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Unified style upgrade v4 — PaperBanana 3-reference guided.
Style extracted from 3 matplotlib replicas (line chart, heatmap, forest plot)
of PaperBanana references. Key change from v3: layer colors harmonized with
PB palette (#C0392B academic red / #2C3E50 navy), heatmap cream gaps."""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, Rectangle
from matplotlib.colors import LinearSegmentedColormap
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
import numpy as np
import json
import os

OUTDIR = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-be-idea-gen-0519-4/projects/policy_ambiguity_safety/docs/paper/figures'
DATA_DIR = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-be-idea-gen-0519-4/projects/policy_ambiguity_safety/artifacts/figures/paper'

# ============================================================
# STYLE CONFIG — unified from 3 PaperBanana replicas (Step 4)
# ============================================================

# --- A. Shared rcParams ---
RC_BASE = {
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.serif': ['DejaVu Serif', 'Times New Roman', 'serif'],
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.02,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'axes.linewidth': 0.8,
    'pdf.fonttype': 42,
    'ps.fonttype': 42,
}

def rc_column():
    return {**RC_BASE, 'font.size': 8, 'axes.labelsize': 8,
            'xtick.labelsize': 7, 'ytick.labelsize': 7, 'legend.fontsize': 6.5}

def rc_full():
    return {**RC_BASE, 'font.size': 9, 'axes.labelsize': 9,
            'xtick.labelsize': 8, 'ytick.labelsize': 8, 'legend.fontsize': 7}

# --- B. Color palette (from PB line chart + heatmap) ---

# Model colors (PB line chart palette)
MODEL_COLORS = {
    'Claude': '#2C3E50', 'GPT-4.1': '#C0392B', 'GPT-5.4': '#16A085',
    'Qwen3': '#D4A017', 'DeepSeek': '#7F8C8D',
}

# Semantic layer colors (from PB forest plot replica)
SPEC_COLOR = '#C0392B'   # PB academic red
LING_COLOR = '#2C3E50'   # PB navy
SPEC_FILL  = '#FDECEA'   # very light rose (PB forest replica)
LING_FILL  = '#EBF0F5'   # very light blue (PB forest replica)

# Neutral
OVERALL_COLOR = '#2D2D2D'
SEPARATOR     = '#444444'
TEXT_DARK     = '#333333'
BG_ALT        = '#f7f7f7'
GRID_COLOR    = '#CCCCCC'
CREAM_BG      = '#FFF5F0'  # PB heatmap cream gap color

# --- C. Colormaps ---

# Heatmap (from PB heatmap replica — extended deeper)
HEATMAP_CMAP = LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list('pb_red', [
    '#FFF5F0', '#FEE0D2', '#FCBBA1', '#FC9272',
    '#FB6A4A', '#EF3B2C', '#CB181D', '#99000D', '#67000D'
])

# Variance decomposition (blue-gray sequential)
VAR_COLORS = ['#2166ac', '#4393c3', '#92c5de', '#d1e5f0', '#bdbdbd', '#737373']

# Cross-benchmark (derived from layer colors)
CB_COLORS = {'tau2': SPEC_COLOR, 'sop': LING_COLOR, 'health': '#E69F00'}
CB_DOTS   = {'tau2': '#E8A09A', 'sop': '#8FA8C0', 'health': '#F0BE55'}

# Convergent nocuity stacked bar
CN_COLORS = {'perm': '#D55E00', 'rest': '#56B4E9', 'lit': '#AAAAAA'}

# --- D. Type-specific design params ---

# Forest plot
FOREST = {'marker_size': 6, 'ci_width': 1.8, 'annot_fontsize': 6.5,
           'diamond_size': 7, 'edge_width': 0.6, 'stroke_width': 2}

# Heatmap
HEATMAP = {'gap': 0.03, 'border_radius': 0.02, 'cell_edge': 'white',
           'cell_edge_width': 0.3, 'text_threshold': 45, 'bold_hi': 55, 'bold_lo': 18}

# Stacked bar / line
BAR = {'width': 0.58, 'ref_line_alpha': 0.5, 'ref_line_width': 0.7}
LINE = {'width': 1.8, 'marker_size': 7, 'marker_edge_width': 2, 'marker_fill': 'white'}


def save(fig, name):
    fig.savefig(f'{OUTDIR}/{name}.pdf', format='pdf')
    fig.savefig(f'{OUTDIR}/{name}.png', format='png')
    plt.close(fig)
    print(f'OK: {name}')


# ============================================================
# Fig 3: Variance Decomposition (column-width)
# ============================================================
def gen_variance_decomposition():
    plt.rcParams.update(rc_column())
    components = [
        ('Clause wording\n(within-type)', 22.0, VAR_COLORS[0]),
        ('Condition\n(ambig vs unamb)', 15.8, VAR_COLORS[1]),
        ('Model', 1.0, VAR_COLORS[2]),
        ('Type\n(between)', 0.4, VAR_COLORS[3]),
        ('Residual\n(stochastic)', 15.2, VAR_COLORS[4]),
        ('Residual\n(systematic)', 45.6, VAR_COLORS[5]),
    ]
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.3, 2.0))
    left = 0
    for label, val, color in components:
        ax.barh(0, val, left=left, height=0.5, color=color,
                edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.8)
        if val >= 10:
            ax.text(left + val / 2, 0, f'{val}%', ha='center', va='center',
                    fontsize=6.5, fontweight='bold', color='white')
        left += val

    ax.annotate('1.0%', xy=(22.0 + 15.8 + 0.5, 0.28),
                xytext=(22.0 + 15.8 + 0.5 - 5, 0.62),
                fontsize=5.5, ha='center', va='bottom', color='#555555',
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color='#999999', lw=0.5))
    ax.annotate('0.4%', xy=(22.0 + 15.8 + 1.0 + 0.2, 0.28),
                xytext=(22.0 + 15.8 + 1.0 + 0.2 + 5, 0.62),
                fontsize=5.5, ha='center', va='bottom', color='#555555',
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color='#999999', lw=0.5))

    ae = 39.2
    ax.axvline(x=ae, color=SEPARATOR, linestyle='--', linewidth=0.8,
               ymin=0.08, ymax=0.92)
    ax.annotate('Actionable 39.2%', xy=(ae / 2, -0.38),
                fontsize=6.5, ha='center', va='top', color=VAR_COLORS[0], fontweight='bold')
    ax.annotate('Residual 60.8%', xy=(ae + (100 - ae) / 2, -0.38),
                fontsize=6.5, ha='center', va='top', color=VAR_COLORS[5], fontweight='bold')

    ax.set_xlim(0, 100); ax.set_ylim(-0.65, 0.85)
    ax.set_xlabel('Proportion of variance (%)', fontsize=7)
    ax.set_yticks([]); ax.spines['left'].set_visible(False)

    patches = [mpatches.Patch(facecolor=c[2], edgecolor='white', label=c[0])
               for c in components]
    ax.legend(handles=patches, loc='upper center', bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 1.55),
              ncol=3, fontsize=5.5, frameon=False, handlelength=1.0,
              handletextpad=0.3, columnspacing=0.8)
    plt.tight_layout(pad=0.3)
    save(fig, 'fig_variance_decomposition')


# ============================================================
# Fig 4: Model × Type Heatmap (column-width)
# ============================================================
def gen_heatmap():
    plt.rcParams.update(rc_column())
    models = ['Claude', 'GPT-4.1', 'GPT-5.4', 'Qwen3', 'DeepSeek']
    type_labels = ['Auth.\nScope', 'Incompl.', 'Cond.\nPrec.', 'Scopal', 'Lexical', 'Coref.']
    data = np.array([
        [12, 48, 36, 32, 32, 22],
        [46, 58, 36, 38, 34, 32],
        [64, 46, 34, 42, 42, 18],
        [26, 62, 40, 37, 52, 42],
        [60, 54, 38, 48, 54, 44],
    ], dtype=float)

    nr, nc = data.shape
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.3, 2.2))
    ax.set_facecolor(CREAM_BG)  # PB heatmap cream gap
    norm = matplotlib.colors.Normalize(vmin=0, vmax=70)
    gap = HEATMAP['gap']

    for i in range(nr):
        for j in range(nc):
            val = data[i, j]
            rect = FancyBboxPatch(
                (j - 0.5 + gap, i - 0.5 + gap), 1 - 2*gap, 1 - 2*gap,
                boxstyle=f"round,pad={HEATMAP['border_radius']}",
                facecolor=HEATMAP_CMAP(norm(val)),
                edgecolor=HEATMAP['cell_edge'], linewidth=HEATMAP['cell_edge_width'])
            ax.add_patch(rect)
            tc = 'white' if val > HEATMAP['text_threshold'] else TEXT_DARK
            fw = 'bold' if val >= HEATMAP['bold_hi'] or val <= HEATMAP['bold_lo'] else 'normal'
            ax.text(j, i, f'{val:.0f}%', ha='center', va='center',
                    fontsize=7, color=tc, fontweight=fw)

    ax.set_xlim(-0.5, nc - 0.5); ax.set_ylim(nr - 0.5, -0.5)
    ax.axvline(x=2.5, color=SEPARATOR, linewidth=0.8, zorder=5)
    ax.set_xticks(range(nc))
    ax.set_xticklabels(type_labels, fontsize=6.5, linespacing=0.85)
    ax.set_yticks(range(nr))
    ax.set_yticklabels(models, fontsize=7)
    for i, lb in enumerate(ax.get_xticklabels()):
        lb.set_color(SPEC_COLOR if i < 3 else LING_COLOR)
    ax.text(1.0, nr + 0.05, 'Specification', ha='center', va='top',
            fontsize=6.5, color=SPEC_COLOR, fontweight='bold', fontstyle='italic')
    ax.text(4.0, nr + 0.05, 'Linguistic', ha='center', va='top',
            fontsize=6.5, color=LING_COLOR, fontweight='bold', fontstyle='italic')
    ax.tick_params(axis='both', which='both', length=0)
    for sp in ax.spines.values(): sp.set_visible(False)

    sm = plt.cm.ScalarMappable(cmap=HEATMAP_CMAP, norm=norm); sm.set_array([])
    cbar = fig.colorbar(sm, ax=ax, shrink=0.82, pad=0.03, aspect=20)
    cbar.set_label('Violation rate (%)', fontsize=6.5)
    cbar.set_ticks([0, 20, 40, 60])
    cbar.ax.tick_params(labelsize=6, length=2)
    cbar.outline.set_linewidth(0.3)
    plt.tight_layout(pad=0.3)
    save(fig, 'fig3_heatmap')


# ============================================================
# Fig 5: Cross-benchmark (column-width)
# ============================================================
def gen_cross_benchmark():
    plt.rcParams.update(rc_column())
    tau2_models = [('LLaMA', 20.0), ('Claude', 25.7), ('Qwen3', 32.4),
                   ('Gemini', 33.6), ('GPT-4.1', 34.7), ('GPT-5.4', 38.3), ('DeepSeek', 39.0)]
    tau2_summary, tau2_ci = 34.0, (31.3, 36.9)
    tau2_excl_summary, tau2_excl_ci = 31.0, (27.9, 34.1)
    sop_models = [('DeepSeek', 5.3), ('GPT-5.4', 6.1), ('Claude', 15.1),
                  ('GPT-4.1', 16.5), ('Qwen3', 20.1)]
    sop_summary = 12.7
    health_models = [('Claude', 48.0), ('GPT-4.1', 54.0), ('Qwen3', 56.0),
                     ('GPT-5.4', 66.0), ('DeepSeek', 70.0)]
    health_summary = 58.8

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.3, 1.9))
    rows_cfg = [
        ('SOPBench', 0, CB_COLORS['sop'], sop_summary, None, sop_models, CB_DOTS['sop']),
        (r'$\tau^2$-bench'+'\nexcl. incompl.', 1, '#8B4444', tau2_excl_summary, tau2_excl_ci, [], None),
        (r'$\tau^2$-bench', 2, CB_COLORS['tau2'], tau2_summary, tau2_ci, tau2_models, CB_DOTS['tau2']),
        ('Healthcare\npilot', 3, CB_COLORS['health'], health_summary, None, health_models, CB_DOTS['health']),
    ]

    for label, ypos, color, sval, ci, models, dc in rows_cfg:
        if ypos % 2 == 0:
            ax.axhspan(ypos - 0.45, ypos + 0.45, color=BG_ALT, zorder=0)
        if models:
            jitter = np.linspace(-0.15, 0.15, len(models))
            for i, (mn, val) in enumerate(models):
                ax.scatter(val, ypos + jitter[i], marker='o', s=18,
                          c=dc, alpha=0.7, zorder=3, edgecolors='white', linewidths=0.3)
                if ypos == 2 and mn == 'LLaMA':
                    ax.annotate(mn, (val, ypos+jitter[i]), xytext=(-2,-8),
                               textcoords='offset points', fontsize=5, color='#666666', ha='center')
                elif ypos == 2 and mn == 'Gemini':
                    ax.annotate(mn, (val, ypos+jitter[i]), xytext=(0,6),
                               textcoords='offset points', fontsize=5, color='#666666', ha='center')
        if ci:
            ax.plot([ci[0], ci[1]], [ypos, ypos], color=color, linewidth=FOREST['ci_width'],
                    zorder=4, solid_capstyle='butt')
            for x in ci:
                ax.plot([x, x], [ypos-0.06, ypos+0.06], color=color, linewidth=1.2, zorder=4)
        ax.scatter(sval, ypos, marker='D', s=80, c=color, edgecolors='white', linewidths=0.8, zorder=5)
        rightmost = sval
        if models: rightmost = max(rightmost, max(v for _,v in models))
        if ci: rightmost = max(rightmost, ci[1])
        ax.text(rightmost+2.0, ypos, f'+{sval:.1f}', ha='left', va='center',
                fontsize=7, fontweight='bold', color=color)
        if models:
            ax.text(min(v for _,v in models)-1.5, ypos, f'n={len(models)}',
                    ha='right', va='center', fontsize=5.5, color='#999999', style='italic')

    ax.axvline(x=0, color='#cccccc', linewidth=0.6, zorder=1)
    ax.set_yticks(range(4))
    ax.set_yticklabels([r[0] for r in rows_cfg], fontsize=7, linespacing=0.85)
    ax.set_xlabel(r'Effect size ($\Delta$pp)', fontsize=8)
    ax.set_xlim(-5, 82); ax.set_ylim(-0.55, 3.55)
    ax.tick_params(axis='y', length=0)
    ax.spines['left'].set_visible(False)
    ax.xaxis.grid(True, alpha=0.2, linestyle=':', linewidth=0.4, color=GRID_COLOR)
    handles = [
        Line2D([0],[0], marker='D', color='w', markerfacecolor='#888888',
               markersize=6, markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=0.5,
               label='Pooled effect', linestyle='None'),
        Line2D([0],[0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor='#aaaaaa',
               markersize=4, alpha=0.7, label='Per-model', linestyle='None'),
        Line2D([0],[0], color='#888888', linewidth=1.2, label='95% CI'),
    ]
    ax.legend(handles=handles, loc='lower right', fontsize=5.5,
             framealpha=0.92, handletextpad=0.3, borderpad=0.3)
    plt.tight_layout(pad=0.3)
    save(fig, 'fig_cross_benchmark')


# ============================================================
# Fig 6: Forest Plot (column-width)
# ============================================================
def gen_forest_plot():
    plt.rcParams.update(rc_column())
    LAYER_MAP = {'authorization_scope':'spec','incompleteness':'spec',
                 'conditional_precedence':'spec','scopal':'ling','lexical':'ling','coreferential':'ling'}
    DISPLAY = {'authorization_scope':'Auth. Scope','incompleteness':'Incompleteness',
               'conditional_precedence':'Cond. Prec.','scopal':'Scopal','lexical':'Lexical','coreferential':'Coreferential'}

    def wilson_ci(p, n, z=1.96):
        if n == 0: return 0.0, 0.0
        d = 1 + z**2/n; c = (p + z**2/(2*n))/d
        m = z*np.sqrt((p*(1-p) + z**2/(4*n))/n)/d
        return max(0.0, c-m), min(1.0, c+m)
    def newcombe_ci(p1, n1, p2, n2, z=1.96):
        l1,u1 = wilson_ci(p1,n1,z); l2,u2 = wilson_ci(p2,n2,z)
        d = p1-p2
        return d-np.sqrt((p1-l1)**2+(u2-p2)**2), d+np.sqrt((u1-p1)**2+(p2-l2)**2)

    with open(os.path.join(DATA_DIR,'..','..','full_study','analysis','full_statistics.json')) as f:
        stats = json.load(f)
    be = stats['binary_effect']
    td = []
    for k,v in be['per_type'].items():
        td.append({'key':k,'name':DISPLAY[k],'layer':LAYER_MAP[k],
                   'p_a':v['ambiguous_rate'],'p_u':v['unambiguous_rate'],
                   'diff':v['difference'],'p_val':v['fisher_p']})
    spec_rows = sorted([d for d in td if d['layer']=='spec'], key=lambda x: -x['diff'])
    ling_rows = sorted([d for d in td if d['layer']=='ling'], key=lambda x: -x['diff'])
    rows = spec_rows + ling_rows; n_spec = len(spec_rows)
    for d in rows:
        lo,hi = newcombe_ci(d['p_a'],250,d['p_u'],250)
        d['ci_lo'],d['ci_hi'] = lo*100, hi*100; d['dpp'] = d['diff']*100
    g = be['global']
    o_lo,o_hi = newcombe_ci(g['ambiguous_rate'],1499,g['unambiguous_rate'],1499)
    overall = {'dpp':g['difference']*100,'ci_lo':o_lo*100,'ci_hi':o_hi*100}

    nt = len(rows); oy = nt + 0.7
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.3, 3.0))
    ax.axhspan(-0.5, n_spec-0.5, color=SPEC_FILL, alpha=0.6, zorder=0)
    ax.axhspan(n_spec-0.5, nt-0.5, color=LING_FILL, alpha=0.6, zorder=0)
    ax.axvline(0, color='#888888', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.5, zorder=1, alpha=0.5)
    ax.axvline(overall['dpp'], color=OVERALL_COLOR, linestyle=':', linewidth=0.6, alpha=0.3, zorder=1)

    for i, d in enumerate(rows):
        c = SPEC_COLOR if d['layer']=='spec' else LING_COLOR
        ax.plot([d['ci_lo'],d['ci_hi']], [i,i], color=c,
                linewidth=FOREST['ci_width'], solid_capstyle='round', zorder=3)
        ax.plot(d['dpp'], i, 'o', color=c, markersize=FOREST['marker_size'],
                markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=FOREST['edge_width'], zorder=4)
        t = ax.text(d['ci_hi']+1.2, i, f"+{d['dpp']:.0f}",
                    fontsize=FOREST['annot_fontsize'], color=c,
                    va='center', ha='left', fontweight='bold')
        t.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=FOREST['stroke_width'], foreground='white')])

    ax.plot([-3,65], [nt-0.5+0.1]*2, color='gray', linewidth=0.4, alpha=0.4, zorder=2)
    ax.plot([overall['ci_lo'],overall['ci_hi']], [oy,oy], color=OVERALL_COLOR,
            linewidth=FOREST['ci_width'], solid_capstyle='round', zorder=3)
    ax.plot(overall['dpp'], oy, 'D', color=OVERALL_COLOR, markersize=FOREST['diamond_size'],
            markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=FOREST['edge_width'], zorder=4)
    t = ax.text(overall['ci_hi']+1.2, oy, f"+{overall['dpp']:.1f}",
                fontsize=FOREST['annot_fontsize'], color=OVERALL_COLOR,
                va='center', ha='left', fontweight='bold')
    t.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=FOREST['stroke_width'], foreground='white')])

    ax.set_yticks(list(range(nt))+[oy])
    ax.set_yticklabels([d['name'] for d in rows]+['Overall'], fontsize=7)
    ytl = ax.get_yticklabels()
    for i,d in enumerate(rows):
        ytl[i].set_color(SPEC_COLOR if d['layer']=='spec' else LING_COLOR)
        ytl[i].set_fontweight('semibold')
    ytl[-1].set_color(OVERALL_COLOR); ytl[-1].set_fontweight('bold')

    ax.set_xlabel(r'$\Delta$ Violation rate (pp)', fontsize=8)
    ax.invert_yaxis(); ax.set_xlim(-3, 65); ax.set_ylim(oy+0.4, -0.5)
    ax.spines['left'].set_visible(False); ax.tick_params(axis='y', length=0)
    ax.legend(handles=[
        mpatches.Patch(facecolor=SPEC_FILL, edgecolor=SPEC_COLOR, linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.7, label='Specification'),
        mpatches.Patch(facecolor=LING_FILL, edgecolor=LING_COLOR, linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.7, label='Linguistic'),
    ], loc='lower right', fontsize=6, framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='#cccccc')
    plt.tight_layout(pad=0.3)
    save(fig, 'fig2_forest_plot')


# ============================================================
# Fig 7: Type-Mechanism Heatmap (column-width)
# ============================================================
def gen_type_mechanism():
    plt.rcParams.update(rc_column())
    raw = {'Auth. scope':[4,28,72,0],'Cond. prec.':[50,10,10,22],
           'Coreferential':[37,29,5,8],'Incompleteness':[43,70,16,5],
           'Lexical':[42,54,10,1],'Scopal':[81,4,13,0]}
    type_order = ['Incompleteness','Auth. scope','Cond. prec.','Lexical','Scopal','Coreferential']
    mechs = ['Structural\nmisparse','Information\ngap-filling','Boundary\nviolation']
    data = np.zeros((len(type_order), 3))
    for i,t in enumerate(type_order):
        counts = raw[t][:3]; total = sum(raw[t])
        for j in range(3): data[i,j] = counts[j]/total*100

    nr, nc = data.shape
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.3, 2.4))
    ax.set_facecolor(CREAM_BG)
    norm = matplotlib.colors.Normalize(vmin=0, vmax=85)
    gap = HEATMAP['gap']
    for i in range(nr):
        for j in range(nc):

# ============================================================
# Fig 8: Convergent Nocuity (full-width)
# ============================================================
def gen_convergent_nocuity():
    plt.rcParams.update(rc_full())
    types_sorted = ['Auth.\nScope','Scopal','Incomp.','Lex.','Coref.','Cond.\nPrec.']
    perm = [99,78,78,76,75,51]; rest = [0,15,16,21,9,47]; lit = [1,7,6,3,16,2]
    models = ['GPT-5.4','GPT-4.1','Claude','Qwen3','DeepSeek']
    jm = np.array([[1.00,0.54,0.38,0.49,0.52],[0.54,1.00,0.41,0.48,0.50],
                    [0.38,0.41,1.00,0.39,0.42],[0.49,0.48,0.39,1.00,0.55],
                    [0.52,0.50,0.42,0.55,1.00]])

    fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(7.0, 3.0),
                                    gridspec_kw={'width_ratios': [1.15, 1], 'wspace': 0.32})
    # Panel (a)
    x = np.arange(len(types_sorted)); bw = BAR['width']
    ax1.bar(x, perm, bw, color=CN_COLORS['perm'], label='Permissive', zorder=3)
    ax1.bar(x, rest, bw, bottom=perm, color=CN_COLORS['rest'], label='Restrictive', zorder=3)
    bl = [p+r for p,r in zip(perm, rest)]
    ax1.bar(x, lit, bw, bottom=bl, color=CN_COLORS['lit'], label='Literal', zorder=3)
    ax1.axhline(y=77.0, color=SEPARATOR, linewidth=BAR['ref_line_width'],
                linestyle='--', zorder=2, alpha=BAR['ref_line_alpha'])
    ax1.text(5.55, 78.5, '77%', ha='left', va='bottom', fontsize=7.5,
             color='#555555', fontstyle='italic')
    ax1.set_xticks(x); ax1.set_xticklabels(types_sorted, fontsize=7.5,
                                             ha='center', linespacing=0.85)
    ax1.set_ylabel('Violation direction (%)', fontsize=9)
    ax1.set_ylim(0, 106); ax1.set_xlim(-0.5, 5.75)
    ax1.set_title('(a) Permissive attractor', fontsize=9.5, fontweight='bold', pad=5)
    ax1.legend(fontsize=7, framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='none', loc='upper left',
               bbox_to_anchor=(0.0, 0.98))

    # Panel (b) — Jaccard heatmap
    jm_norm = matplotlib.colors.Normalize(vmin=0.25, vmax=0.60)
    jm_cmap = plt.cm.YlOrRd; gap = HEATMAP['gap']
    for i in range(5):
        for j in range(5):
            if i == j:
                ax2.add_patch(Rectangle((j-0.5,i-0.5), 1, 1,
                             facecolor='white', edgecolor='#DDDDDD', linewidth=0.5, zorder=3))
                continue
            val = jm[i,j]
            rect = FancyBboxPatch((j-0.5+gap, i-0.5+gap), 1-2*gap, 1-2*gap,
                                  boxstyle=f"round,pad={HEATMAP['border_radius']}",
                                  facecolor=jm_cmap(jm_norm(val)),
                                  edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.3, zorder=2)
            ax2.add_patch(rect)
            tc = 'white' if val > 0.50 else TEXT_DARK
            ax2.text(j, i, f'.{int(val*100):02d}', ha='center', va='center',
                    fontsize=9, color=tc, fontweight='bold')

    ax2.set_xlim(-0.5, 4.5); ax2.set_ylim(4.5, -0.5)
